hypothesis: Increasing observation_delay_ms beyond 100ms while keeping other variables nominal will cause the finger to touch the floor before the push completes.
reason_to_test: The random baseline showed all 3 safety failures occurred when observation_delay_ms >= 152ms, and a minimized counterexample confirmed failure at 140ms with nominal other variables. Nominal delay (0ms) passes reliably.
expected_failure_signature: Finger contacts the floor during the push motion due to delayed state estimation.
